caption: Figure 1. Number of PSI catalog entries per combustion investigation, split by the PSI file category (third path component of the object key). Source: PSI /files/v2 catalog retrieved in this run. Unit: catalog entry.
Figure 2. Percentage of empty/'none'/'n/a' cells per column in each raw PSI experiment table (grey = column does not exist). Source: data/raw/psi/tables. Unit: table column.
Figure 3. Ambient conditions of FLEX tests by fuel and diluent; dashed lines are constant O2 partial pressure. Source: PSI-69 experiment table (test with 0 mmHg excluded). Unit: droplet test.

Figure 4. Burning-rate constant from the PSI table versus an independent OLS fit of d² against t on 0.2–0.9 of the visible burn time of each raw droplet history. Left: files matched through the CIR identifier and NASA/TP-2015-216046 numbering. Right: files matched by the table's row number. Unit: droplet test.

Figure 5. FLEX burning-rate constant versus ambient O2 mole fraction, by diluent. Source: PSI-69 table (K) re-keyed to official FLEX numbering. Unit: droplet test. Regression coefficients with bootstrap 95% intervals (2,000 resamples of tests) are in Table T05.

Figure 6. Ratio of visible-flame extinction diameter to initial droplet diameter versus X_O2 for FLEX tests that ended in extinction with a measured diameter. Source: PSI-69 table. Unit: droplet test.

Figure 7. FLEX-035 (heptane, air, 102.4 kPa). Top: measured d² with OLS fits during visible burning and after visible extinction. Bottom: UV (LLUV) camera signal as provided in PSI (sparser sampling). Vertical dashed line: tabulated visible burn time; dotted line: time when the rolling regression rate first falls below 10% of K. Source: PSI-69 raw files.

Figure 8. Duct anemometer readings around ignition (red line) for Saffire-II samples 2-5 and 2-6. Source: PSI-99 telemetry workbook (RawData sheet, 1 Hz), extracted to data/processed/saffire2_telemetry_windows.csv.

Figure 9. BASS-II: distribution of calibrated initial O2 and final CO versus O2 drop per test point (points with physically implausible O2 increase excluded). Source: PSI-25 experiment table. Unit: test point.
Figure 10. SAME-R smoke particle arithmetic mean diameter by material and versus aging time. Source: PSI-101 results workbook, reduced data sheet. Unit: smoke-generation test.

Figure 11. n-Dodecane droplet extinction diameters for hot and cool flames versus pressure, experiment and model, as provided in PSI-117 analysed data (PROCI 2023). Source: PSI-117. Unit: experimental condition (values as published).
Figure 12. Ambient pressure and O2 mole fraction of individual PSI combustion tests versus proposed exploration atmospheres (stars; NTRS 20260002050) and the ISS cabin. Unit: test.

Figure 13. Coded evidence coverage. 'Direct' = measured in the regime the decision concerns; 'partial' = related measurement in a different regime, conditions only, or literature-only result; 'none' = no relevant data. Coding rules are documented in SCIENTIFIC_METHODS.md. Mars gravity has no test data in any source examined.
